title: Bachchhan Paandey
desc: To succeed in the film industry, Myra chooses Bachchhan Paandey, a notorious hooligan, as the main focus of her new movie. Things get complicated when the gangster decides to act in the film.

title: Raja Saheb Ka Kamra
desc: A television channel decides to host a reality show in a haunted house with seven contestants. The ghosts, however, have their own motives and obstruct the organisers' plans.

title: Khiladi 786
desc: A father who runs a matrimonial agency believes that his son is a failure in life. To prove him wrong, the son takes on the task of finding a match for a gangster's sister.

title: Singh Is Kinng
desc: Happy, notoriously famous for his antics, is sent to fetch Lakhan so that he can meet his ailing father. But, in Australia, Happy ends up taking Lakhan's place as the king of the local underworld.

title: Krack
desc: Fiery officer Potharaju Shankar faces off against three dangerous outlaws. Meanwhile, their fierce feud quickly leads to unexpected consequences for everyone involved.
